build.beforeDevCommand: npm run sidecar && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run sidecar && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; media-src 'self' blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription:
Save X (Twitter) posts to your own disk: text, photos, videos and documents, organized and searchable, with no account or cloud.

Guarda posts de X (Twitter) en tu propio disco: texto, fotos, vídeos y documentos, organizados y con búsqueda, sin cuenta ni nube.
